edits.anchor: Psychosis only during mood episodes is a mood disorder with psychotic features.
edits.html: Criterion A with a major mood episode, plus delusions or hallucinations 2 weeks or more without one, and mood episodes for most of the illness, is schizoaffective disorder.

Schizoaffective disorder types Bipolar type – a manic episode is part of the illness; major depressive episodes may also occur · Depressive type – major depressive episodes only · Either type – a depressive episode must include depressed mood; anhedonia alone does not count, since it is a common negative symptom of schizophrenia

edits.with: Delusional disorder – antipsychotic plus psychotherapy · Schizoaffective disorder – a second-generation antipsychotic; for bipolar type, a mood stabilizer (lithium or valproate) may be added; for depressive type, an SSRI (selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor) may be added for persistent depressive symptoms
